title: Implement FT-005 photo upload HTTP routes and integrated evidence
verify: Protected FT-005 routes match Photo Intake HTTP multipart request policy, catalog response shapes, no-store behavior, UUID/timestamp/enum handling, and stable errors.

Upload API tests prove accepted JPEG/PNG/WebP, 20 MiB rejection, unsupported media rejection, missing file, invalid photo_type, invalid optional check_in_id, checksum/timeline failures, and no raw exception leaks.

Authorization tests prove Boss/Engineer upload and catalog reads while Consultant, unauthorized Plant, revoked grant, disabled membership, and archived normal-operation paths fail closed without accepted artifacts.
Integrated flow proves an Engineer with tomato_001 access uploads a valid photo and receives photo_id, sha256, original_file_ref, manifest_ref, event_refs, local_only=true, and can_train_on=false.
FT-005 docs remain synchronized without claiming Vision processing, dataset trainability transition, Plant history UI, timeline pagination, export UI, remote sync, or PWA completion.

verify.summary: Independent functional verification passed. Focused FT-005 API tests passed 13/13, combined photo-intake/API tests passed 26/26, full regression passed 215/215 with existing warnings, mb-lint passed, diff-check passed, and targeted multipart/OpenAPI/size-boundary probes passed.

Adversarial semantic verification passed. The protected FT-005 HTTP routes satisfy the task-scoped multipart upload/catalog contract, preserve service authority, authorization, no-leak/no-store behavior, local-only and can_train_on=false defaults, and avoid downstream Vision/dataset/history/export/sync/PWA overclaim. The stdlib MIME parser plus manual OpenAPI requestBody is accepted as task-scoped behavior with a residual maintenance/API-compatibility risk.

The task exposes protected local photo upload/catalog behavior but does not authorize physical actuation, dataset trainability, remote sync, or Vision inference; product safety, local-only, no-leak, and source-of-truth rules remain satisfied by tests and semantic review.

constraints: Use the photo intake service from TASK-021; do not implement acceptance logic directly in route handlers.
Expose only FT-005 photo upload and catalog routes; do not implement Vision processing, Plant history UI, timeline pagination, export UI, remote sync, or PWA behavior.
Return no-leak denials for missing, unauthorized, revoked, wrong-Farm, or archived normal-operation paths.
Responses, manifests, timeline events, logs, screenshots, exports, and evidence must omit auth material, absolute paths, user-controlled destination paths, provider payloads, and hidden reasoning.
invariants: Catalog reads use PostgreSQL/read model and never scan manifests or files as current authority.
photo_id is the single accepted-photo identity and is the same UUID as photo_artifact_id.
Accepted photos remain local_only=true and can_train_on=false.
Timeline refs remain audit/export refs and never become Plant state authority or dataset trainability authority.
verification_targets: Inspect generated OpenAPI for the documented FT-005 routes, response shapes, upload policy, and errors.
Trace FT-005-BHV-001 through FT-005-BHV-003 to concrete API/integration tests.
purpose: Expose the completed FT-005 photo intake service through protected HTTP routes and prove the end-to-end authorized local photo upload behavior.
success_outcome: FT-005 is implementable as a backend feature: protected photo routes accept only authorized valid local photos, return safe catalog refs, and preserve local-only and non-trainable defaults with focused integrated evidence.

No dataset trainability approval, registry, or fine-tuning path.
No Plant history UI, timeline pagination, export UI, remote sync, or PWA implementation.
No feature lifecycle overclaim beyond FT-005 backend photo intake.
